value.rationale: The literature explicitly treats statistical redundancy between bi-invariant permutation metrics and Spearman-family rank metrics as a substantive question. The trace law gives a reusable exact finite answer for every permutation linear statistic, not only one metric pair: cycle count sees precisely the difference between diagonal and grand array means. Its Cayley–Spearman specialization sharpens qualitative asymptotic decoupling to an exact covariance and a sharp correlation scale of order 1/sqrt(n log n).
